source: build-database-yield.js over odds-archive/*.csv, the same run that writes database-yield.json
priceRule: Pinnacle closing, else Bet365 closing, per row (build-market-edge.js pickBook)
filters: ATP main tour, all levels incl. Finals, all surfaces, seasons 2010 on; completed matches, plus retirements settled on Pinnacle rules (settlement.js settleBet: after the first set was completed the bet stands on the result; before it, or with no set scores, void); walkovers excluded; exact price ties and overround > 1.15 excluded; favourite = the shorter price; flat 1u, a win pays price − 1
